description: This source file defines the ShcheckProcessor class, which implements the IProcessor interface. It processes a JSON file generated by an external tool to identify missing security headers and reports vulnerabilities based on that data.

classes.name: ShcheckProcessor
classes.description: Implements processing logic for integrating with Shcheck tool, identifying missing security headers, and reporting vulnerabilities.
